macro_event.name: Breaking Macro Event
macro_event.description: NEW SIGNAL: Joint US-Japan yen intervention (Aug 1-3, 2026). First coordinated action since 1998. $59B intervention. US sold euros to buy yen. Japan pledged FIMA repo for future interventions. South Korea also intervened.
macro_event.note: CONVERGENCE EVENT: This event touches Financial (Treasury selling), Currency (yen intervention), Geopolitical (US-Japan alliance signaling to China), and Energy (Iran war driving Japan import costs) domains simultaneously. See data/blackwatch-events/2026-08-03-japan-us-yen-intervention.md for full analysis.
